summary: Tested the 'Segnalazioni e richieste' ticket module end to end. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass covering create with PNG, SA badge count, public reply, internal note with PDF, status changes, closing with a final message, reply on a closed ticket blocked, reopen request (once only), SA reopen, cross-org isolation, 403 on platform routes for org users, validation and SA filters. Frontend desktop (1920) and mobile (390): org new ticket dialog (shadcn select, attachment, confirmation #number), list, detail chat, reply, closed state with date and time, Chiedi la riapertura + pending flag; SA table, counters, search/org/category/status(riapertura)/date filters, detail actions, internal toggle, close dialog, Riapri richiesta, sidebar badge (3 -> 2 after close, +1 after reopen request), mobile drawer link with badge. No horizontal overflow at 390px. Everything works. Only minor UX/robustness issues found.

minor.issue: When subject/description form fields are missing entirely, FastAPI returns 422 (pydantic detail list), not 400. Empty or whitespace values correctly return 400. The UI always sends the fields, so this is low impact.
The date range compares the raw date string with created_at stored as a UTC ISO string. For an Italian user, tickets opened between 00:00 and 01:00/02:00 local time end up on the previous day.

Files are saved to storage before the ticket is inserted. If something fails afterwards (e.g. _next_number), the stored objects are orphaned. Each upload is also read fully into memory before the 10MB check (no streaming cap).

A Super Admin with an acting org (X-Org-Id) can open, reply to and reopen-request tickets as an org (created_by = SA, side='org'). The org-level 'Segnalazioni e richieste' link also shows in the SA sidebar next to the platform one (two identical labels). Consider blocking role=superadmin on the org ticket endpoints or hiding the org link for the SA.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: there is no request cancellation or sequence guard in load(). When filters change quickly (e.g. reset org then set category), an older response can arrive last and overwrite the newer one, so the table shows unfiltered rows. Reproduced once: category=altro showed all 3 rows. Re-checked in isolation and it works. The search input also fires a request on every keystroke with no debounce.

The 'Nota interna' switch stays ON after an internal note is sent. The next message the SA types is internal by default, so the org never sees it. Consider resetting it to public after sending or making the internal state more prominent.

issues: Native <input type=date> shows browser-locale mm/dd/yyyy instead of an Italian format / shadcn Calendar date picker
Native <select> elements look different from the shadcn Select used in the org dialog
The global floating green widget button (bottom-left) overlaps the 'Chiedi la riapertura' and 'Invia richiesta' buttons inside the dialogs. It does not fully block them but covers their left edge.

action_items: Reset the internal-note toggle after sending (or warn clearly) in the SA ticket composer
Add a request-sequence guard or AbortController plus a search debounce in PlatformTickets load()
Optional: return 400 instead of 422 for missing form fields (default Form('') + manual check)
Optional: use the Europe/Rome day boundaries for the SA date filter; replace native date inputs with a shadcn Calendar
Optional: block superadmin on the org /api/tickets endpoints or hide the org 'Segnalazioni' link for the SA
Optional: check the floating widget overlapping the dialog buttons on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: tickets.py looks good overall: org scoping on every org query (tickets/messages/files with org_id + internal False), magic-byte validation, file Response with nosniff + CSP sandbox, an atomic counter for numbers, an audit on status changes, and _id excluded everywhere

sa_reply on an internal note does not update updated_at (correct). A public SA reply on a closed ticket is allowed and does not change status. Acceptable, but the org then sees a new message on a closed ticket.
Orphaned storage objects if insertion fails after _store_files; ticket files are never deleted from storage
